1. go to {object_location} ({search for the object})  
2. observe contents of {object_location} ({inspect the location})  
3. take {object} from {object_location} ({pick up the object})  
4. go to {appliance} ({navigate to the appliance})  
5. open {appliance} ({open the appliance})  
6. move {object} to {appliance} ({place the object inside the appliance, even if another object is already there})  

Workflow: clean_and_place_in_receptacle  
When to use: when an object needs to be cleaned and then placed in a receptacle  
Steps:  
1. go to {object_location} ({locate the object})  
2. take {object} from {object_location} ({pick up the object})  
3. go to {cleaning_location} ({navigate to the cleaning location})  
4. clean {object} with {cleaning_location} ({clean the object})  
5. go to {receptacle} ({navigate to the receptacle})  
6. move {object} to {receptacle} ({place the object in the receptacle})
